gallery.title: Person swap
gallery.lead: Pick a video. Upload your photo. The video stays the same, and the person in it becomes you.

empty.title: No videos yet
empty.text: Person swap videos will show up here once there is one to pick.

gallery.priceUnknown: Price is shown on the next page

form.title: Put yourself in this video
form.lead: Upload a photo of the person who should be in the video. Nothing is charged until you confirm.

aside.label: The video
aside.promise: The video, its cuts and its sound stay as they are. Only the person changes.

tips.title: A photo that works
tips.one: One person only, nobody else in the picture
tips.light: Even light, no strong shadows on the face
tips.frame: Framed like the video: standing, the whole body in the picture
tips.clothes: Clothes that fit, not loose or bulky

body.label: Full-body photo
body.hint: Required. Upright, from head to feet.

face.label: Face photo, close
face.hint: Recommended. It makes the face more like yours.

side.label: Side photo
side.hint: Optional. Taken from the side, for the moments the person turns.

photo.rules: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MB · the short side at least {min} px

error.type: {name} was not added: only JPG, PNG or WebP.
error.size: {name} was not added: it is larger than 10 MB.
error.small: {name} was not added: its short side is under {min} px.
error.landscape: {name} was not added: a full-body photo must be upright (taller than wide).
error.quota: {name} was not added: you have reached today's number of uploads.
error.unreadable: {name} was not added: the file could not be read as a picture.

outfit.keep: Keep the clothes from the video
outfit.photo: Use the clothes from my photo

consent.ownPerson: The person in the photo is me, or I have their written permission
consent.adults: Everybody in the photo is over 18
consent.notCelebrity: Nobody famous, and nobody I do not know
consent.kept: What we keep and for how long: your photos are sent to the AI provider we work with to make the video, and are deleted when the job is finished, at the latest {hours} hours later. The finished video is kept for {days} days, then deleted. It carries an "AI-generated" label in the corner, and the sound of the original video stays.
consent.missing: Tick all three boxes to start.

form.priceNote: You see the credits again and confirm before anything is charged.
form.paused: Generation is paused for a short time. You can fill in the form; starting is off until it is back.
form.review: A person may look at your photo before the video is made; that can take up to {hours} hours. While it waits you can cancel and get every credit back.
form.wait: Wait for the photos to finish uploading.

error.people: The full-body photo is missing or can no longer be used. Add it again.
error.photo: A photo could not be used: it is too small (short side under {min} px), a full-body photo is not upright, or the file cannot be read as a picture. Nothing was charged. Add your photos again and start.
error.consent: Tick all three boxes to start.
error.paused: Generation is paused for a short time. Nothing was charged.
error.gone: This video can no longer be used. Pick another one.
error.generic: The job could not be started. Nothing was charged. Try again.

form.needsPhoto: Add a full-body photo to start.

confirm.title: Confirm and start
confirm.changedPrice: The price changed while this window was open: it is now {now} (was {was}). Nothing was charged.
confirm.changedBalance: Your balance changed while this window was open. Nothing was charged.
confirm.note: If the job stops, everything it was charged comes back to your balance.
